Payload.Name: Electrical Engineering
Payload.Description: Generation, storage and distribution of electricity. Opens the battery, capacitor, conductor, fuel cell, grid, solar panel and thermal plant techs.

Payload.Name: Industrial Base
Payload.Description: Mines, factories, shipyards and the people to run them. Opens the mining, factory, shipyard, construction automation, industrial energy, academy and administration techs.

Payload.Name: Life Sciences
Payload.Description: Biology, medicine and habitat engineering. Opens the closed-loop life support and the six habitat range and extension techs.

Payload.Name: Electromagnetic Sensors
Payload.Description: Detecting and measuring the electromagnetic spectrum. Opens the antenna techs and the Geological Surveyor.

Payload.Name: Gravitic Theory
Payload.Description: Gravity as a field and as geometry: gravitational waves, lensing and the equivalence principle. Opens the Gravitational Surveyor and Spacetime Metric Theory.

Payload.Name: Spacetime Metric Theory
Payload.Description: Solving the field equations for engineered geometries: warp metrics and the negative energy they demand. Opens the Alcubierre Warp Drive. Needs Gravitic Theory.

Payload.Name: Closed-Loop Life Support
Payload.Description: Better air and water recycling, heat recovery and lighting. Multiplies a ship's life support per crew aboard (1 kW at level 0) and the hostile-world term of a sealed colony's life support: x1 at level 0, x0.85 a level, to about x0.27 at level 8. Applies at once to every ship and colony. Needs Life Sciences.

Payload.Name: Habitat Gravity Tolerance
Payload.Description: Widens the infrastructure window on the prefab and the site. It does not move the prefab track. Level 0 is 1.962 m/s² wide. Level 3 is about 6.7 m/s², enough to cover Earth and Mars in one window. Level 6 is about 11.4 m/s², enough to cover Luna through Earth. Needs Life Sciences.

Payload.Name: Low-Gravity Habitat Engineering
Payload.Description: Opens the prefab gravity track down to 0 m/s² so the window can slide toward low-gravity bodies. It does not widen the window. Level 1 reaches 0 m/s². Needs Life Sciences.

Payload.Name: High-Gravity Habitat Engineering
Payload.Description: Opens track above the prefab window so that window can slide toward heavy worlds. It does not widen the window. The five levels reach about 100 m/s². Needs Life Sciences.

Payload.Name: Habitat Pressure Tolerance
Payload.Description: Widens the pressure window on the prefab and the site. It does not move the prefab track. Level 0 is 0.20 atm wide. Level 3 is 0.50 atm wide. Needs Life Sciences.

Payload.Name: Dense-Atmosphere Habitat Engineering
Payload.Description: Opens the ceiling of the prefab track. It does not widen the window. The ceiling is capped at 10 atm, so a runaway-greenhouse atmosphere stays out of reach. Needs Life Sciences.

Payload.Name: Mining Production Efficiency
Payload.Description: Multiplies the kilograms per day of each mine and robo-miner. Level 0 is the installation's own rate. Each level adds 1.5 times that rate. Accessibility still scales each deposit: half at 0.5, one tenth at 0.1. The installations apply this same 1 + level * 1.5 expression. Needs Industrial Base.

Payload.Name: Capacitors
Payload.Description: Higher-energy capacitors. Raises the charge energy of the Missile Launcher (weapons work is deferred, so nothing else reads it yet).

Payload.Name: Advanced Battery Technology
Payload.Description: Advanced materials and manufacturing raise battery energy density, up to threefold at the peak. Feeds the Battery Bank and the Grid Battery. Needs Electrical Engineering.

Payload.Name: Conductors
Payload.Description: Better conductors and thermoelectrics. Raises the RTG's thermoelectric conversion by 0.5 points a level (6% at level 0) and adds to the Missile Launcher's power efficiency. Needs Electrical Engineering. Level 1 opens Electric Thrusters.

Payload.Name: Electric Thrusters
Payload.Description: Driving propellant with electricity instead of heat: high-voltage power handling, grids and ion optics. Opens the Ion Drive. Needs Conductors.

Payload.Name: Alcubierre Miniaturization
Payload.Description: Shrinks the Alcubierre Warp Drive to fit smaller form factors (its minimum mass). Needs Alcubierre Bubble Creation Cost level 3.

Payload.Name: Alcubierre Bubble Creation Cost
Payload.Description: Better ways to shape the warp bubble cut the energy the Alcubierre Warp Drive needs to create it. Needs Alcubierre Warp Drive.

Payload.Name: Alcubierre Sustain Cost
Payload.Description: Better ways to hold the warp bubble cut the power the Alcubierre Warp Drive draws to sustain it. Needs Alcubierre Warp Drive. Level 4 opens Alcubierre Bleed and Gravitational Coupling.

Payload.Name: Alcubierre Gravitational Coupling
Payload.Description: A lower coupling eases the reactor draw of an uphill warp with the Alcubierre Warp Drive. Needs Alcubierre Sustain Cost level 4. Level 3 opens Alcubierre Collapse Efficiency.

Payload.Name: Alcubierre Bleed
Payload.Description: How much of its drive speed the Alcubierre Warp Drive may keep on a downhill warp. Needs Alcubierre Sustain Cost level 4.

Payload.Name: Alcubierre Collapse Efficiency
Payload.Description: Recovers some of the energy put into creating the bubble when the Alcubierre Warp Drive collapses it in a controlled manner. Needs Alcubierre Gravitational Coupling level 3.

Payload.Name: Rocket Engine Maximum Power
Payload.Description: Raises the upper end of the engine power range. In this build only the Alcubierre Warp Drive's Efficiency vs Power slider reads it. Needs Chemical Rocketry.

Payload.Name: Rocket Engine Minimum Power
Payload.Description: Lowers the bottom of the engine power range. In this build only the Alcubierre Warp Drive's Efficiency vs Power slider reads it. Needs Chemical Rocketry.

Payload.Name: Solid Fuel
Payload.Description: Solid propellant grains. Nothing reads this yet; it is parked for solid-rocket ordnance.

Payload.Name: Rocket Engine Maximum Size
Payload.Description: Better cooling allows larger engines. Raises the maximum size of the Conventional Engine and the Nuclear Solid Core Engine. Needs Chemical Rocketry.

Payload.Name: Rocket Engine Minimum Size
Payload.Description: Miniaturization allows smaller engines. Lowers the minimum size of the Conventional Engine and the Nuclear Solid Core Engine. Needs Chemical Rocketry.

Payload.Name: Rocket Engine Exhaust Velocity
Payload.Description: Higher exhaust velocities make the Conventional Engine more efficient. Needs Chemical Rocketry.

Payload.Name: Rocket Engine Fuel Consumption
Payload.Description: Better plumbing and pump layouts improve the Conventional Engine's fuel efficiency (and the SRB's). Needs Chemical Rocketry.

Payload.Name: Chemical Rocketry
Payload.Description: Burning propellant in a nozzle. Opens the rocket engine tuning techs (exhaust velocity, fuel consumption, size and power) and Solid Fuel. Improves the Conventional Engine.

Payload.Name: Nuclear Theory
Payload.Description: The physics behind fission: cross-sections, moderation and criticality. Opens Nuclear Power and Nuclear Engines.

Payload.Name: Nuclear Engines
Payload.Description: Putting a reactor behind the nozzle. Opens the nuclear solid core engine line, which leads on to the nuclear pulse engine. Needs Nuclear Theory.

Payload.Name: Nuclear Solid Core Engine Technology
Payload.Description: Better fuel and core temperatures for the nuclear thermal rocket: raises the Nuclear Solid Core Engine's exhaust velocity by 250 m/s a level. Needs Nuclear Engines. Level 3 opens the Nuclear Pulse Engine.

Payload.Name: Nuclear Pulse Engine Technology
Payload.Description: Nuclear pulse propulsion. There is no pulse drive component yet, so this has no effect for now. Needs Nuclear Solid Core Engine Technology level 3.

Payload.Name: Ion Drive Technology
Payload.Description: Ion propulsion: very high exhaust velocity at low thrust. There is no ion thruster component yet, so this has no effect for now. Needs Electric Thrusters.

Payload.Name: JumpPoint Stabilization
Payload.Description: A ship equipped with a stabiliser module could stabilise a jump point. The module is not in the game yet, so this has no effect for now. Needs Gravitational Surveyor.

Payload.Name: JumpPoint Size Reduction
Payload.Description: Reduces the size of the component required for jump point stabilisation. No stabiliser module exists yet, so this has no effect for now. Needs JumpPoint Stabilization.

Payload.Name: JumpPoint Time Reduction
Payload.Description: Reduces the time it takes to stabilise a jump point. No stabiliser module exists yet, so this has no effect for now. Needs JumpPoint Stabilization.

Payload.Name: High Explosives
Payload.Description: Better explosive compounds increase the Relative effectiveness factor

Payload.Name: HE Warheads
Payload.Description: High Explosive Warheads that produce a large amount of heat and pressure

Payload.Name: Fragmentation Warheads
Payload.Description: Warheads that produce a large amount of fragmentation

Payload.Name: Fission Warheads
Payload.Description: Warheads that produce massive amounts of Heat and pressure

Payload.Name: Laser Warheads
Payload.Description: Smart warheads that fire a high energy beam towards the target on detonation

Payload.Name: Trigger Tech
Payload.Description: Enables different warhead triggers for ordnance

Payload.Name: Guidance Tech
Payload.Description: Enables different guidance options ordnance

Payload.Name: Antenna Sensitivity
Payload.Description: Better antennas pick up smaller signals from background noise. Feeds the Passive Sensor. Needs Electromagnetic Sensors.

Payload.Name: Antenna Efficiency
Payload.Description: Better antennas raise the effective area of a sensor, giving more sensitivity for a smaller size. Feeds the Passive Sensor. Needs Electromagnetic Sensors.

Payload.Name: Antenna Bandwidth
Payload.Description: Better antennas raise the maximum bandwidth of an antenna. Feeds the Passive Sensor. Needs Electromagnetic Sensors.

Payload.Name: Factory Maximum Size
Payload.Description: Research into the logistics and design of larger factories. Raises the maximum size of the Factory and the Factory Site. Needs Industrial Base.

Payload.Name: Shipyard Slip Maximum Size
Payload.Description: Research into the logistics and design of larger slips. Raises the maximum size of the Shipyard. Needs Industrial Base.

Payload.Name: Larger Academy Classes
Payload.Description: A naval academy can take a larger class Needs Industrial Base.

Payload.Name: Better Academy Instruction
Payload.Description: Graduates and command courses leave with a higher experience cap Needs Industrial Base.

Payload.Name: Academy Candidate Search
Payload.Description: A class can be drawn from a smaller colony Needs Industrial Base.

Payload.Name: Geological Surveyor
Payload.Description: Geological surveys of system bodies. Unlocks the Geological Surveyor; further levels raise its maximum survey speed. Needs Electromagnetic Sensors.

Payload.Name: Asteroid Mining
Payload.Description: Mining asteroids from a ship. Unlocks the Asteroid Miner. Needs Mining Production Efficiency level 3.

Payload.Name: Gravitational Surveyor
Payload.Description: Surveying gravitational anomalies to find jump points. Unlocks the Gravitational Surveyor and opens JumpPoint Stabilization. Needs Gravitic Theory.

Payload.Name: Solar Panel Efficiency
Payload.Description: Improves the base absorption efficiency of solar panels. Feeds the Solar Array and the Solar Farm. Needs Electrical Engineering.

Payload.Name: Solar Panel Bandwidth
Payload.Description: Increases the maximum tunable bandwidth of solar panels. Feeds the Solar Array and the Solar Farm. Needs Electrical Engineering.

Payload.Name: Solar Panel Density
Payload.Description: Reduces the mass per square metre of solar panels. Feeds the Solar Array and the Solar Farm. Needs Electrical Engineering.

Payload.Name: Nuclear Power
Payload.Description: Fission reactors, steam turbine reactors and RTGs. Needs Nuclear Theory. Leads on to directed energy and to Reactor Power Conversion.

Payload.Name: Directed Energy
Payload.Description: Lasers and the beam fire control that aims them.

Payload.Name: Alcubierre Warp Drive
Payload.Description: The Alcubierre Warp Drive and the research lines that improve it: bubble creation and sustain costs, then gravitational coupling, bleed, miniaturization and collapse efficiency. Needs Spacetime Metric Theory.

Payload.Name: Thermal Plant Efficiency
Payload.Description: Better boilers, turbines and heat recovery. The share of fuel heat a thermal plant, methalox turbine or fission plant turns into electricity: 33% at level 0, +3 points a level. Simple-cycle plants stop at 45% (fission plants always do); Combined Cycle lifts the cap to 60%. New plant designs pick up the level; built plants keep the efficiency they were designed with. Needs Electrical Engineering.

Payload.Name: Combined Cycle
Payload.Description: A steam cycle on the gas turbine's exhaust. Raises the thermal plant efficiency cap from 45% to 60% (methalox turbines to 55%). Opened by Thermal Plant Efficiency level 4, where simple-cycle plants reach the 45% cap.

Payload.Name: Fission Power Plant
Payload.Description: Grid-scale fission: a reactor and turbine hall for a colony. Unlocks the fission power plant. Needs Nuclear Power.

Payload.Name: Reactor Power Density
Payload.Description: Hotter cores and better fuel. Multiplies a ship reactor's heat per kg of fuel (and so its output and fuel burn): x1 at level 0, +0.25 a level. New reactor designs pick up the level.

Payload.Name: Reactor Power Conversion
Payload.Description: Brayton and Stirling conversion for ship reactors: the share of reactor heat turned into electricity, 30% at level 0, +1.5 points a level. The steam turbine reactor uses this value; its core runs hot enough that a 2 tonne plant still gives 15 kW at level 0.

Payload.Name: Grid Distribution
Payload.Description: Better transformers and lines. The share of generated power a colony grid delivers: 92% at level 0, +0.75 points a level, to 98%. Applies to every colony at once. Needs Electrical Engineering.

Payload.Name: Industrial Energy Efficiency
Payload.Description: Efficient motors, furnaces and heat recovery. Multiplies the build energy every industry point spends (refining, fabrication and assembly): x1 at level 0, -5% a level, to x0.6. Applies to running jobs at once; a design's listed build energy stays the level 0 figure. Needs Industrial Base.

Payload.Name: Construction Automation
Payload.Description: Assembly robots, powered tools and machine-guided fitting. Multiplies the crew a ship's construction bay needs: x1 at level 0, x0.85 a level, to about x0.27 at level 8. Applies to bays designed after the research; existing designs keep their crew. Needs Industrial Base.

Payload.Name: Construction Bay
Payload.Description: A crew-served module for a colony ship that can install buildings on a new world. Unlocks the Construction Bay. Needs Construction Automation level 2.

Payload.Name: Fuel Cells
Payload.Description: Hydrogen and methane fuel cells: non-nuclear ship power from tank propellant. Unlocks the fuel cell generator (about 60 W/kg, half a kilogram of propellant per kWh). Needs Electrical Engineering.
